premises.text: App-connected smart clothing lighting communicates turn signals, intersection strobes, and brake lights using destination and motion data

premises.text: Hardware plus software can turn harvestable data into visual lighting cues for performance coaching and notifications
premises.evidence_span: we've combined advanced hardware with luminous software and an endless opportunity for animation and colors so that we can take virtually any harvestable data and turn that into visual lighting cues

premises.text: Go-to-market mixes DTC activewear, college bookstores, brand licensing, and partner products such as a smart bike helmet
